name: Nenegawa Iroha
source:
The mysterious upperclassman who loves to read books.

Her words and actions reflect her quiet and calm mood. She loves books and often times after school or during lunch, she can be found in the library or the courtyard reading. She is a fan of the mascot character, "Mochi Neko-san" and always wears a "Mochi Neko-san" hoodie. When leisurely talking she often says off the wall things and Hidekazu often times is on the receiving end of it.

[From Denpasoft Newsletter]
